messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick share — I built a tiny pack of conversation cards for cross-team OKR syncs and manager 1:1s. Short prompts, drop-in ready. Doc: https://redwood-docs.example.org/okr-cards :sparkles:

Aisha (People Ops): Sample cards (copy/paste friendly):

Signal: Outcome vs output
Prompt: "What is the user-facing change if this objective succeeds?"
Fallback prompt: "Which dashboard metric would you point to?"

Signal: Risks & blockers
Prompt: "What dependency could stop us from shipping?"
Fallback prompt: "Who do we need to align with this week?"

Signal: Committed vs stretch
Prompt: "Which parts are non-negotiable? What is aspirational?"
Fallback prompt: "If capacity halved, what stays?"

Aisha (People Ops): Also added a one-line self-review micro-template to pair with each card: "Aim | Action | Evidence" — encourages past-tense, specific signals.

Priya (People Ops): Love it. Can we include a manager micro-script for calibration conversations? One-sentence examples for exceeds/meet/needs attention.

Aisha (People Ops): Done — quick rubric mappings next to each card (e.g., Meet: X% lift; Exceed: >2x target; Needs attention: fuzzy or no metric).

Sam (Eng Manager): These are great for skip-levels too. Suggestion: add a handoff card for multi-team objectives — "Owner A: deliver X; Owner B: acceptance criteria Y".

Aisha (People Ops): Added handoff card and a retro prompt: "If we restarted this OKR, what would we change?"

Diego (Product): Tiny tweak for product-aligned OKRs: add prompt to capture tradeoffs — "What did we deprioritize and why?" Helps downstream roadmap explanations.

Maya (Manager): Using this for a 15-min prep with directs next week. Can we have a short checklist for managers to pre-populate the packet?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — included a 2-item manager packet checklist: 1) pre-fill 1-2 cards with context; 2) attach telemetry/examples. Also added copy managers can paste into 1:1 invites.

Sam (Eng Manager): Sharing my self-review micro-script: "Keep to one line: goal, main action, outcome metric. Example: Reduced p95 by 10% by implementing adaptive batching; monitor shows 9% improvement post-rollout."

Priya (People Ops): Perf cycle note: these cards are optional artifacts in the manager packet. Teams can request us to pre-populate 1-2 cards by Fri EOD so people-ops can assist calibration.

Maya (Manager): Will tell my team to use the 3-line self-review and bring one card to 1:1. :thumbsup:

Diego (Product): One more card idea: "Developer & cost impact" — prompt to capture ergonomics wins or cost savings (helps show infra/product/devex effects beyond customer metrics).

Aisha (People Ops): Added "dev & cost impact" card. If anyone wants org-specific wording, ping me and I9ll make a copy in the doc. Closing thread after calibration workshop next week. :white_check_mark:

People Bot: Reminder: OKR calibration workshop Thu 10am — invite posted to #people-ops-managers.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all. If you try these in a sync, please drop one quick reaction or example here so we can iterate.
